index.title: 1. What is Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker?
index.summary: Enterprise-grade WordPress plugin that turns raw merchant URLs into clean, branded, trackable links hosted on your own domain.
index.content: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker is an enterprise-grade WordPress plugin. Under the hood: Custom Post Type salc_link holds each link (title = name, slug = path); RewriteEngine.php adds top-priority rules ^go/([^/]+)/?$; RedirectEngine.php hooks template_redirect:1, resolving slugs via 24h transient caching (salc_link_slug_{slug}); ClickTracker.php records clicks to local DB table wp_salc_clicks with bot filtering (30+ signatures), GDPR IPv4/IPv6 anonymization, and Cloudflare geo.

index.title: 2. Why is Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker Essential?
index.summary: Trust & CTR, SEO Safety, Compliance by Default (Amazon §6 & FTC), Attribution control, and Operations at scale.
index.content:
2.1 Trust & CTR: Branded links (yourdomain.com/go/best-vpn) signal ownership and survive shortener bans.
2.2 SEO Safety: Auto-injects rel="nofollow sponsored" + target="_blank", sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, and adds Disallow: /go/ in robots.txt.
2.3 Compliance by Default: Smart ToS Uncloaking detects amazon.* / amzn.to and renders raw URLs on frontend while beacon-tracking clicks (compliant with Amazon §6). FTC Auto-Disclosure inserts accessible <aside role="note">.
2.4 Attribution Control: UTM/gclid/fbclid/msclkid/wbraid forwarding, per-visitor geo/OS/device routing, split-test variants, zero SaaS lock-in.
2.5 Scale: Date or click-cap expiration -> 302 fallback or 410 page, nightly HEAD batch 20 health checks, DOM-safe keyword auto-linking, 1-click migration.

index.title: 5. Who Actually Needs This Plugin?
index.summary: Target personas (Needs It) vs Anti-personas (Does Not Need It) vs Decision Checklist.
index.content:
Needs It: Amazon & multi-network affiliates, Coupon/deal sites, Content marketers & newsletters, SaaS reviewers, Course creators selling via Stripe, Agencies managing client portfolios.
Does Not Need It: Pure Amazon-only store with Storefront API, Networks forbidding any redirect, Sites needing link shortening without WordPress.
Decision Checklist: Answer YES to >= 2 -> Choose SALC.

index.title: 7. Technical Architecture Summary
index.summary: Boot PSR-4, Singleton Container, Layer Class Hooks & Order, Storage Schema, Assets, Security nonces & caps.
index.content:
Boot: smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.php defines SALC_PLUGIN_DIR/URL/FILE, registers Autoloader PSR-4, includes Constants.php, hooks register_activation_hook -> Activator::activate, deactivation_hook -> Deactivator::deactivate, instantiates Plugin::getInstance()->run() on plugins_loaded.
Container: Plugin.php singleton with 18 private services + LinkShowcaseWidget on widgets_init. Admin-only: MetaBoxes, AdminMenu, DocsPage.
Hook Order: RewriteEngine (init, early) -> RedirectEngine (template_redirect:1, first) -> SplitTester (salc_resolved_destination_url:9, order 1) -> ConditionalRouter (salc_resolved_destination_url:10, order 2) -> QueryForwarder (salc_resolved_destination_url:11, order 3) -> SmartUncloaker (the_content:15, before link) -> KeywordLinker (the_content:18, mid) -> DisclosureInjector (the_content:19, after links) -> CrawlerController (the_content:20, last).
Storage: wp_salc_clicks (id BIGINT PK AI, link_id BIGINT idx, clicked_at DATETIME, ip_address VARCHAR45, referrer TEXT, user_agent TEXT, os VARCHAR20, browser VARCHAR20, device VARCHAR20, country_code CHAR2, city VARCHAR100, region VARCHAR100, language VARCHAR100, is_bot TINYINT) + postmeta (_salc_destination_url, _salc_total_clicks, _salc_unique_clicks, _salc_lifetime_clicks, _salc_variant_clicks/map, _salc_health_*, _salc_stripe_*) + options (salc_global_settings, salc_auto_link_rules, salc_health_cursor).
Assets: admin.css, analytics.js (Chart.js), uncloak-beacon.js, gutenberg.js, tinymce-button.js, plugin-meta.js/deactivation-survey.js.
Security: nonces salc_save_settings_nonce, salc_export_links, salc_export CSV, salc_deactivation_feedback; caps manage_options; sanitization sanitize_text_field/esc_url_raw/int; ABSPATH guard every file.

index.title: 8. Glossary of Key Terms
index.summary: Definitions for Affiliate Link, Cloaked URL, Slug, Prefix, Redirect Type, Smart ToS Uncloaking, Beacon, FTC Disclosure, UTM/Query Forwarding, Keyword Auto-Linker, Transient, GeoResolver, Health Status, Split Tester, Anonymize IP, X-Robots-Tag, CPT/Taxonomy, REST Routes.
index.content:
Affiliate Link: Merchant URL with tracking param crediting you for sales.
Cloaked URL: Branded alias that redirects to merchant. Post Type salc_link slug.
Slug: URL-safe identifier (best-vpn) from post post_name.
Prefix: Global base directory (go default, Constants:22).
Redirect Type: 301, 302, 307 (default uncached), 200 iFrame Mask.
Smart ToS Uncloaking: Frontend display of raw destination for regulated merchants while beacon-tracking clicks.
Beacon: navigator.sendBeacon POST to salc/v1/track to log uncloaked clicks without redirect.
FTC Disclosure: Legally required affiliate notice injected as <aside role="note">.
UTM / Query Forwarding: Allowlist-based append of utm_* / gclid / fbclid from incoming $_GET to destination.
Keyword Auto-Linker: DOM-safe conversion of keywords to links via DOMDocument XPath.
Transient: WP cache with TTL (salc_link_slug_* 24h, salc_geo_* 1h, salc_github_release 6h).
GeoResolver: Resolves country/city from HTTP_CF_IPCOUNTRY / GEOIP_* cached 1h.
Health Status: ok (<400) vs broken (>=400 or WP_Error) stored in postmeta _salc_health_status.
Split Tester: A/B variant rotation weighted_random (mt_rand cumulative) vs sequential transient.
Anonymize IP: Mask last octet IPv4 /64 IPv6 before DB for GDPR.
X-Robots-Tag: HTTP header noindex, nofollow, noarchive sent on redirect.
CPT / Taxonomy: salc_link Custom Post Type; aff_category hierarchical, aff_tag flat.
REST Routes: salc/v1/track (beacon), salc/v1/stripe-webhook (Stripe).

index.title: 9. Frequently Asked Questions
index.summary: 15 detailed answers to common questions about prefix changes, Amazon compliance, redirect types, uninstall vs deactivation, 404 troubleshooting, statistics, auto-linker, UTM forwarding, Stripe checkout, FTC disclosure, health scanner, deal expiration, PrettyLinks/ThirstyAffiliates migration, DB search & replace, GDPR support, and updates.
index.content:
Q: Will changing my prefix break old links?
A: Yes — go -> shop makes /go/... 404. Add 301s via Redirection plugin or keep go and add new alias rule.
Q: Does Amazon allow this?
A: Yes with Smart ToS Uncloaking ON (default). Amazon links render as raw URLs on frontend (compliant with §6) but clicks are beacon-tracked.
Q: Which redirect should I use?
A: 307 Temporary Redirect default (uncached, every click reaches server & increments counter). Use 301 only for permanent moves. Use 200 iFrame mask with branded bar.
Q: What happens on uninstall vs deactivation?
A: Deactivate = rewrites flushed, cron unscheduled, data kept. Delete (uninstall) = uninstall.php drops wp_salc_clicks + deletes options/transients/postmeta/termmeta + clears cron.
Q: My cloaked link 404s?
A: Check: Activated? Settings -> Permalinks -> Save. Valid slug? Prefix matches Settings?
Q: Why isn't Statistics updating?
A: Confirm redirect is 307. Check range All and wp_salc_clicks not empty. Verify BotDetector isn't flagging UA as bot. Ensure salcBeacon.restUrl enqueued.
Q: Why didn't auto-link appear?
A: Keyword must match word boundary (?<!\w)kw(?!\w), case-insensitive, not in h1-h6/a/code/pre/script/style or salc-skip-linker ancestor. Check thresholds.
Q: Why didn't UTM forward?
A: Check Settings -> UTM allowlist includes utm_* or your key. Incoming must be $_GET key <500 chars.
Q: Stripe Checkout not working?
A: Verify stripe_secret_key sk_... and price_ ID correct. Endpoint salc/v1/stripe-webhook set in Stripe Dashboard.
Q: Disclosure not showing?
A: Ensure disclosure_enabled ON globally or per-post not disabled. Content must contain affiliate signal.
Q: Health scanner shows Broken but link works in browser?
A: HealthScanner uses HEAD 10s timeout, fallback GET on 405/501; some hosts block headless UA. Whitelist User-Agent SALC-HealthChecker.
Q: How do expiring deals work?
A: Set Expires At UTC or Max Clicks + optional Fallback URL. When expired, 302s to fallback or renders expired.php 410 with custom message.
Q: How to migrate from PrettyLinks/ThirstyAffiliates?
A: Tools -> tab Migration -> Migrate PrettyLinks or Migrate ThirstyAffiliates, preserves click counts.
Q: Will Search & Replace break my posts?
A: Use Dry Run first. Scope is post,page,publish post_content. Back up DB first.
Q: Do you support GDPR?
A: Yes — Anonymize IP ON masks before insert. No cookies set by plugin; data deleted on uninstall.
Q: How are updates delivered?
A: Dual-source Updater.php checks api.github.com/repos/.../releases/latest + api.wordpress.org every 6h.
